author: Brenton Kemp
title: Michael McGreevy pushed back to Tuesday versus Brewers
desc: Cardinals right-hander Michael McGreevy will start one of the two doubleheader games on Tuesday against the Brewers.
impact: The Cardinals announced Dustin May as Monday's starter for the series opener against the Brewers, pushing McGreevy back to one of the doubleheader games on Tuesday. McGreevy has been excellent with a 3.12 ERA in 17 starts this season, but a tiny 15.9% K% alongside a 5.58 xERA, 4.13 xFIP, and a 4.53 SIERA suggest he has been fortunate to post that surface ERA.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Byron Buxton leaves Sunday's game early
desc: Byron Buxton was lifted from Sunday's game against the Yankees in the second inning.
impact: The exact reason for his removal is currently unknown, but he has been dealing with a hip issue and seemed to get up awkwardly after being thrown out on a steal attempt in the first inning. Kyler Fedko has replaced Buxton in center field.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Dustin May to start Monday versus Brewers
desc: Cardinals right-hander Dustin May is scheduled to start Monday's game against the Brewers.
impact: May was hit on the ankle by a line drive in his last start on Thursday, but appears good to go for Monday's series opener against the rival Brewers. The right-hander has posted a 4.80 ERA across 16 starts this season, although his 3.89 xFIP and 3.94 SIERA suggest he is due for some better fortunes moving forward.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jaden Hill (shoulder) to throw bullpen session Sunday
desc: Rockies right-hander Jaden Hill (shoulder) will throw his first bullpen session on Sunday.
impact: Hill, sidelined since June 24 with right shoulder tendinitis, has played catch recently, but has now progressed to throwing a bullpen session. The 26-year-old has posted a 5.06 ERA across 32 appearances for the Rockies this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Jeremy Pena (calf) to play in rehab games this week
desc: Astros shortstop Jeremy Pena (calf) is on track to play rehab games this week, with the hope of rejoining the team next weekend, according to manager Joe Espada.
impact: Espada believes Pena will be good to go for next weekend's series in Texas, which aligns with the hope Pena would need just the minimum time on the injured list. The 28-year-old has been enjoying another nice season when healthy, hitting .295 with six homers, eight stolen bases, and a .799 OPS across 48 games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Tim Tawa recalled from Triple-A
desc: The D-backs have recalled infielder/outfielder Tim Tawa from Triple-A Reno.
impact: Tawa has raked at Triple-A, but has struggled in the big leagues. The 27-year-old has hit .172 with a homer and eight RBI in 76 plate appearances for the D-backs this season, while hitting .320 with seven homers, 21 RBI, and two stolen bases across 20 games for Reno.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: LuJames Groover optioned to Triple-A
desc: The D-backs have optioned infielder LuJames Groover to Triple-A Reno.
impact: Groover has appeared in 15 games for the D-backs this season, hitting just .167 with a homer and four RBI across 54 trips to the plate. Utility man Tim Tawa was promoted from Reno in a corresponding move.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Davis Wendzel designated for assignment
desc: The Pirates have designated infielder Davis Wendzel for assignment.
impact: The Pirates made a procedural move on Sunday, selecting the contract of right-hander Noah Murdock, meaning the club needed to clear a spot on the 40-man roster. It will cost Wendzel his spot for the time being. The 29-year-old has made just four plate appearances for the Bucs this season and is hitting .230 with 10 homers, 38 RBI, two stolen bases, and an .810 OPS across 65 games this season for Triple-A Indianapolis.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Noah Murdock selected, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Pirates have selected the contract of right-hander Noah Murdock and have optioned him to Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: The move appears procedural, as Murdock had an upward mobility clause in his contract. With the move, the right-hander will stay with the Pirates' organization. The 27-year-old has posted a 4.11 ERA across 24 outings for Indianapolis this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Sean Sullivan headed back to minors
desc: The Rockies are sending left-hander Sean Sullivan back down to Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Sullivan was summoned to start Saturday's contest against the Giants after Tomoyuki Sugano was scratched with back spasms, and he surrendered six earned runs across 5 2/3 innings of work. He will head back down to Albuquerque to work on some things before likely heading back to the big leagues at some point after the All-Star break.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: TJ Shook to be recalled by Rockies
desc: The Rockies are recalling right-hander TJ Shook from Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Shook will switch spots with left-hander Sean Sullivan, who was summoned to start Saturday's game against the Giants. The right-hander has appeared in three games for the Rockies this season and has posted a 2.89 ERA across 30 appearances for the Isotopes.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chandler Simpson (finger) back in lineup Sunday
desc: Chandler Simpson is back in the Rays lineup on Sunday against the Astros.
impact: Simpson returns from a two-game absence. He is batting fifth and back in left field.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Quintana (elbow) to begin playing catch Monday
desc: Jose Quintana begin playing catch on Monday in Los Angeles.
impact: Quintana has done fine throwing weighted balls as he continues to progress. He is scheduled to undergo a follow-up MRI.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Rom recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Brewers recalled Drew Rom from Triple-A Nashville.
impact: Rom will add a fresh arm for Milwaukee with Brandon Woodruff placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brandon Woodruff (shoulder) placed on IL
desc: The Brewers placed Brandon Woodruff on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation.
impact: Woodruff left Saturday's start early with the injury. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.
